text:
# Newsletter

## Requirements

- Subscribers must be able to withdraw consent and have their data erased within 30 days, under Privacy Policy 6.

## Stories

- As a subscriber, I want to withdraw my consent to marketing so that I stop receiving it.
- As a subscriber, I want to pick topics so that I only get what I like.
